messages:
Priya: quick note — onboarding quickstart has drifted across languages. curl example in sample-apps/README.md references REDWOOD_API_TOKEN while SDK examples use REDWOOD_KEY. New users copy/paste curl + SDK and see auth mismatch.

Marta: ack. Which lines? Can you paste the curl snippet?

Priya: sure: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```

Priya: meanwhile Python quickstart shows 
```
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
```
so people expect REDWOOD_KEY but the curl suggests REDWOOD_API_TOKEN = confusing.

Kevin: thanks — we did a variable rename last year and some legacy snippets never got updated. I'll open a docs PR to normalize to REDWOOD_KEY across quickstarts and add a brief migration note.

Sam: also spotted that the README claims "client retries enabled by default" but only the Java/Go SDKs have built-in retry behavior. We should add a two-line "SDK behavior" callout near the top that lists exceptions (Python/JS opt-in). Otherwise folks assume idempotent flows will auto-retry.

Marta: good catch Sam — add a link to the SDK retry docs and an example middleware snippet for Node and Python. That should deflect support tickets.

Priya: another tiny nit: the Node snippet uses `new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOODKEY })` (missing underscore) — saw at least one support thread where a user mis-typed the env var and kept getting 401s.

Kevin: ugh. I'll fix the underscore and the curl env var in one PR. Also update CONTRIBUTING.md to mention env var canonical name (REDWOOD_KEY) so template generators don't spin up bad examples.

docs-bot: Issue created: docs#824 "Quickstart env var + retry callout" and labeled docs/triage. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/issues/824

Sam: If you want me to patch the onboarding generator template too, I can follow up after the PR merges. We should avoid repeating this in new repos.

Priya: that'd be great. For now, a small one-paragraph "Troubleshooting auth" card in the quickstart would help — mention common typos (REDWOODKEY vs REDWOOD_KEY vs REDWOOD_API_TOKEN).

Kevin: PR 459 opened: replaced REDWOOD_API_TOKEN with REDWOOD_KEY, fixed Node env var typo, added "SDK behavior" callout and troubleshooting card. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/459

Marta: quick review done, left one comment about phrasing in the retry callout. lgtm otherwise.

Sam: merged PR 459. I'll run a quick smoke test against the onboarding generator once the CI artifacts publish.

Priya: verified the updated quickstart locally — copy/paste works with REDWOOD_KEY and the troubleshooting card is helpful. Thanks y'all :sparkles:
